research:
I found 9 things from 30 Oct to 13 Nov. Most are rollouts that only reach some people, so the "who gets it" part matters as much as the feature. Where a source isn't from the company itself, I say so.

**New free tools and features**

1. **ChatGPT can make GIFs and remember your photos (Images 2.6, 4 Nov).** You can ask for a looping GIF, or upload a sketch and have it animated. You can also save a photo once and call it back in any chat by typing @ and its name. *Why care:* it's a free-feeling WhatsApp sticker or status trick, and the saved photo saves re-uploading. *Catch:* it's still rolling out, and OpenAI's pages I found don't say whether free users get it. Check on a free account before saying "free." [OpenAI announcement](https://community.openai.com/t/images-upgraded-introducing-chatgpt-images-2-6/1412901) · [Images help page](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11084440-images-in-chatgpt)

2. **ChatGPT locked chats (announced 20 Oct, still reaching people).** You can hide a chat behind a 4-digit PIN or your fingerprint. *Why care:* shared family phones and nosy siblings. It's officially for Free, Go, Plus and Pro. *Catch:* this is slightly older than 14 days. One forum post (not OpenAI) says resetting a forgotten PIN deletes the locked chats, so don't repeat that as fact. [OpenAI help: locked chats](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001411-using-locked-chats-in-chatgpt) · [Release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)

3. **Gemini can order food and book cabs in India for you (10 Nov, beta).** It opens your other apps and does the steps. *Why care:* it's the clearest "AI does the task, not just the chat" example yet in India. *Catch:* only Pixel 10 and newer (not 10a), English only, 18+, and it's arriving in stages over weeks. Google hasn't said which Indian apps work. A leak (SamMobile, not Samsung) says 2026 Galaxy phones get it later. [Google India blog](https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/hardware/pixel-10-with-gemini-intelligence-custom-widgets-and-more-in-our-november-pixel-drop/) · [Google Android blog](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence-november-features-devices/)

4. **Rambler voice typing in Gboard, with Hindi (November Pixel Drop).** You speak messily and it writes clean text with the filler words removed. You can switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence. Long chat summaries now also work in Hindi. *Why care:* it's the most useful item here for people who'd rather speak than type. *Catch:* it's mainly on Pixel 10 for now, in "select countries and languages." [Google Pixel help: Rambler](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/17468539?hl=en)

**Things people get wrong (privacy and limits)**

5. **"Is AI training on my chats?" is the question coming up this month.** On most apps the answer is yes by default, and you can turn it off. New guides came out in November. *Why care:* it's a simple explainer that applies to almost everyone. *Catch:* the guides disagree on some defaults, including Claude's, and they're all third-party sites. Check each company's own settings page before naming any defaults. There is also a report that OpenAI will train on "Daybreak" sessions even if you've opted out, from 29 Nov. I couldn't confirm it with OpenAI, so leave it out for now. [Engadget opt-out guide](https://www.engadget.com/2268598/how-to-stop-ai-companies-training-your-data/) · [Digital Information World, Nov 2026](https://www.digitalinformationworld.com/2026/11/big-tech-ai-training-controls-where-users-can-turn-them-off.html) · [Daybreak report (unverified)](https://explainx.ai/blog/openai-daybreak-blue-personal-sessions-model-training-opt-out-november-29-2026)

6. **The free ChatGPT tier shows ads, and there's a no-ads option with less.** People wonder why answers end in ads. Free users can switch to an ad-free mode, but they get fewer messages and no image making or Deep Research. *Catch:* this started 9 Feb, so it's an old change people are still confused about. The source is a blog, so confirm it in OpenAI's pricing page. [GeoToolbox pricing](https://geotoolbox.ai/blog/chatgpt-pricing)

**Scams that use AI**

7. **Cloned-voice "family emergency" calls.** A 9 Nov article cites a McAfee survey: 47% of Indian adults have faced an AI voice scam or know someone who has, and 83% of those victims lost money. A few seconds of audio is enough to copy a voice. *Why care:* this is the one most worth sending to parents. The advice: hang up, call back on the saved number, agree on a family code word, never share an OTP or UPI PIN, and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. *Catch:* the figures come through a blog. I couldn't find a 6 Nov government advisory that one article mentions, so don't cite it. [VARINDIA](https://www.varindia.com/news/three-seconds-to-steal-a-voice) · [CareerIndia](https://www.careerindia.com/features/ai-deepfake-bank-fraud-safety-guide-for-indian-students-2026-011-68211.html)

8. **I4C and CERT-In warned about AI-assisted attacks on banks and fintechs (3 Nov).** The attackers reportedly test with ₹1 payments before moving real money. *Why care:* it backs up "check every unknown ₹1 credit or collect request." *Catch:* the warning was written for banks, not the public, and I only saw press reports, not the advisory itself. [Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/tech/i4c-cert-in-warn-banks-and-fintech-firms-of-ai-driven-cyberattacks-flag-risk-of-multi-crore-financial-fraud) · [The Federal](https://thefederal.com/category/business/i4c-warns-banks-nbfcs-and-fintech-firms-of-ai-assisted-attacks-payment-apis-261866)

**Worth knowing, not worth a reel yet**

9. **New Claude tools (10 to 12 Nov) and Meta AI chats in WhatsApp (4 Nov).**
   - Claude Whiteboards and Sheets are on paid plans, including Pro. Claude Meetings is only for Team and Enterprise plans. Claude Personal Finance is US only.
   - WhatsApp is testing separate, named Meta AI chats with some Android beta users. Text actions (turning a message into a calendar event or a saved contact) are rolling out to everyone.
   - *Why care:* people will ask "can I use this?" For now, mostly no.

   [Claude release notes](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/) · [WABetaInfo](https://wabetainfo.com/whatsapp-is-rolling-out-chats-powered-by-meta-ai-on-android/) · [BetaNews](https://betanews.com/article/meta-rolls-out-text-actions-to-whatsapp/)

**What came up empty:**
- **NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook):** no confirmed November change. The newest items I found are from October, including free textbooks added as sources on 29 Oct. They come from blogs.
- **Canva, CapCut, Apple:** nothing confirmed in the last 14 days.

**Where these could fit the fixed slots:**
- Items 1, 3 and 4 suit tool or tutorial slots with a ranked list card.
- Item 5 suits a prompt or tutorial slot ("turn off AI training in 3 apps") once the defaults are checked on each company's site.
- Item 7 would be a safety explainer. Explain is on hold and SAFE is resting, so it needs Prashant's go-ahead or a later slot.
- Each would need a new keyword with its tool on the tools page first.
